serverInfo.name: apis.io
serverInfo.title: APIs.io API catalog MCP server
serverInfo.description: Read-only Model Context Protocol server over the APIs.io catalog — discover APIs, providers, tags, industries, regions, ratings, and published artifacts. Generated from the same OpenAPI contract that powers the REST API, so the two never drift.

transport.note: Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC. Call initialize, then tools/list, then tools/call. Read-only; no tool mutates catalog state. Free + Starter tiers cover discovery; industries/regions/ratings tools require the Pro or Business tier (https://apis.io/developer/plans/).

available.name: apis_io_search
available.description: Power tool — find APIs, providers, or tags by free text, tags (match any/all), providers, artifact types, industry, region, and rating band.
